howToPlay: Use your Super to attach to teammates for healing or to enemies for damage. Utilize the Cardboard Box gadget to turn invisible and charge your Super. Switch between helping allies with Cheeseburger and playing aggressively to suit the situation.
gears: Equip SPEED and HEALTH to maintain high mobility and survivability. DAMAGE or SHIELD are also great choices to increase your impact during combat.
trait: This brawler suits players who enjoy a hybrid style of tactical support and surprising offensive play.
